intro_text: Our committee comprises passionate medical students from NUS Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine, supported by healthcare advisors, doctors, and community partners.

members.name: Dr Ong Yew Jin
members.bio: Palliative Care Physician and former Medical Director of the Singapore Cancer Society. Dr Ong has mentored Project Battambang since its inception in 2010, advocating for holistic community support beyond medical aid.

members.name: Project Directors
members.bio: Overseeing all sub-committees and spearheading the strategic direction, international partnerships, and logistical execution for Project Battambang.

members.name: Medical Screening Committee
members.bio: Anchoring operational mass health screenings, clinical triage procedures, hospital referral pathways, pharmacy management, and volunteer physician coordination.

members.name: Education Committee
members.bio: Delivering sustainable, year-round aid through health education modules, school hygiene projects, and the Light-A-Dream Scholarship.

members.name: Development Committee
members.bio: Planning long-term project sustainability, evaluating existing initiatives, and conducting on-ground surveys on villager health-seeking behaviors.

members.name: Logistics Committee
members.bio: Managing facility bookings, transport logistics, inventory control, medication supply chains, and mobile pharmacy operations.

members.name: Sponsorship & Finance Committee
members.bio: Maintaining sponsor relations, fundraising, safe-keeping project funds, budgeting transparency, and managing project publicity.
